# Experiments

This directory stores reproducible outputs from model training and evaluation.

## Generated files

- `results.csv` — appended after each final training run. Contains:
  - ticker
  - model name
  - RMSE on return
  - MAE on return
  - directional accuracy
  - selected GA-WOA hyperparameters
  - timestamp
- `plots/ga_convergence.png` — GA-WOA convergence plot generated during optimization.

## Notes

The forecasting target is daily return (`Target_Return`), so RMSE and MAE in `results.csv`
are reported on return values rather than USD prices.

Do not manually enter benchmark numbers. Results should be generated by the training pipeline
so experiments remain reproducible.


## Benchmark

Run the architecture benchmark from the repository root:

```bash
python -m src.benchmark
```

This evaluates LSTM, CNN-LSTM, CNN-LSTM-Attention, and the GA-WOA configured
CNN-LSTM-Attention model on the same preprocessing pipeline and temporal split.
The output is written to `experiments/benchmark_results.csv`.
